title: fix(common): publish native general settings atomically

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The exact-head candidate and guarded six-case runner remain unchanged. Fourteen tool pins and twelve compatible native-cache hashes match, while three NuGet imports and the test assembly are absent. Conditional prerequisite restore, focused build and actual identity discovery are prepared but unrun; the previously passing same-timestamp case is excluded. Source inspection found no fixture-only signal proving that a blocked notification has queued its retry, so supersession sleeps remain a reliability concern. Separate deterministic test instrumentation is being considered without misrepresenting it as part of the literal author-facing correction.
